purpose: Original genus-level Trigonia fossil form, informed by identified T. reticulata; no exact-replica or universal-genus-size claim.

criteria.description: Source/export, clean reimport, deterministic rebuilding, official validator, SI bounds and artifact integrity.
Open all exact-export views. Curved ribbed triangular flank, distinct posterior area, paired inflated volume and actual dorsal depression must be readable.

Compare Fig.5.1–6 and description: equivalved subtriangular shell, opisthogyrate beaks, commarginal flank ribs, carina, reticulate posterior area and depressed elongated-cordate escutcheon. No huge beads or radial scallop ribs.
All source, export, parameter, manifest and provenance deliverables with current hashes; no source reference images in public asset subtree.
Exact GLB loads in pinned Three.js with finite dimensions/materials and no missing dependencies.
Exact GLB rendered in target graphics runtime, with images inspected and renderer/device recorded.
Model included in intended populated museum scene with actual measured scene work.

coverage_justification: Existing static-stylized-v1 eight-view contract plus left/right/bottom/clayalt/wire diagnostic views. Optional turntable not needed for this contract. Target GPU/scene mandatory for acceptance, remain unknown if unavailable to maker.

scale.basis: BSPG 2014V 260/1 Table5; genus form inspired by specimen not scan

mount: Ventral contact Z=0, root identity at footprint center. Upright display, not life-position claim.
style: Palette-only original warm limestone matte faceted style; quiet intercostal spaces; no random texture or huge beads.
feature_obligations: Closed equivalved strongly inflated subtriangular shell with rounded anterior/ventral and truncated posterior
Posterior-directed pointed beaks near anterior quarter
Strong curved commarginal flank ribs separated by broad smooth intervals
Main marginal carina with separate fine-reticulate posterior area and subdued median carina
Depressed elongated-cordate escutcheon, not raised knife edge or deep open slot
No copied images or meshes and no universal-genus-size assertion
